adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` changed their fallback calendar selection from `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. But that `find` is only evaluated in the branch where `externalCalendarId` is falsy, so the predicate compares `cal.externalId === undefined/null` and will not match any real calendar externalId. This effectively removes the previous fallback to the destination calendar and will cause updates/deletes (when no `externalCalendarId` reference is present) to target the wrong calendar (likely default/primary) or have an undefined calendarId depending on downstream usage, leading to missed updates/deletions on non-primary calendars.
